newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing share market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing share market report.

text.p: Dutch shares close some 0.8 percent lower on Friday after a hectic day's trading in which the AEX index of 25 blue chips managed to regain most of an earlier 2.5 percent fall.
The index closed 4.76 points lower at 606.65 but dealers were relieved to see it close above support at 603/604, fearing a much steeper fall if it failed to do so.
"It was touch and go. A close below 603 could have meant slipping toward the 580 level next week," one dealer said.
Heavy options-related activity was reported but dealers said but this did not move the market in any one direction.
"The market makers don't know where they stand at the moment (ahead of next week's expiry), it all depends on New York".
Limited losses for the Dow at the opening were seen as supportive, but the Amsterdam market remained nervous until the close and will continue to watch Wall Street with some anxiety.
Traders said they saw no reason for the Dow to fall heavily today and saw any losses braked by support at 6250.
News of the EU summit in Dublin had little impact.
Foodstocks were volatile but closed above their lows. A big seller pushed Unilever down to 277.60, before the stock climbed to its closing level of 281.00, still 3.60 guilders lower.
